sentences.l2: 在中国许多城市，早点摊前的甜咸之争常常围绕豆浆和豆腐脑展开。
sentences.l1: In many cities in China, the sweet-versus-savory dispute at breakfast stalls often revolves around soy milk and tofu pudding.

sentences.l2: 北方不少地方习惯把豆浆当作清淡饮品，却也有人喜欢在豆腐脑里加卤汁、酱油和香菜；南方一些城市则偏爱甜口，常在豆腐脑上撒糖，或者把豆浆做成甜饮。
sentences.l1: In quite a few places in the north, people are used to treating soy milk as a light drink, yet some also like adding braised sauce, soy sauce and coriander to tofu pudding; some cities in the south prefer a sweet taste, often sprinkling sugar on tofu pudding, or making soy milk into a sweet drink.

sentences.l2: 不同地域的气候、物产和饮食习惯，使人们对早餐的期待并不相同。
sentences.l1: The climate, local products and eating habits of different regions mean that people's expectations of breakfast are not the same.

sentences.l2: 有人觉得甜味能带来温暖，有人相信咸味更耐饱，也有人认为早点不仅要好吃，还要方便携带。
sentences.l1: Some feel that sweetness brings warmth, some believe that saltiness keeps you full longer, and some think that breakfast should not only taste good but also be convenient to carry.

sentences.l2: 其实，无论选择哪一种，都是地方生活经验长期形成的结果。
sentences.l1: In fact, whichever one is chosen, it is the result of local life experience formed over a long time.

sentences.l2: 这种讨论看似琐碎，却折射出不同地区的生活方式。
sentences.l1: This discussion seems trivial, yet it reflects the lifestyles of different regions.

sentences.l2: 理解这种差异，有助于我们看见饮食背后的文化。
sentences.l1: Understanding this difference helps us see the culture behind food.
